Rae T: Quick kickoff thread — LynxLabs + Redwood want a focused perf-per-watt sprint next week. Need owners for runs, telemetry, and an embargoed summary.
LynxLabs (Partner): We'll provide 4x GPU nodes (RDNA-like) and wall meters. Plan: three power setpoints 180W/260W/340W plus a max-power run.
Devon H: I'll handle the harness. Suggested profile: 4h soak per point, steady clients=96, burst tails to 2048. Use redwood-chat-lite v2.
Priya M: Add kernel/drivers: linux-6.1.12, drm 6.1 backport, and our low-latency BIOS. Capture ipmi, NVML, and rack PDU CSVs.
LynxLabs (Partner): We'll also share fan curves and chassis thermals. Can we standardize on seq distribution: 512:0.25,1024:0.5,1536:0.25?
Devon H: yes. I'll pin the model commit and tokenizer in the run script. Example: `bench run --suite perf-w --model redwood-2b --commit d4c3b2 --seq-dist "512:0.25,1024:0.5,1536:0.25" --clients 96 --duration 4h --power 180,260,340`
Priya M: Also record `perf stat` counters and perfetto traces for a 5m sample at each point. We'll checksum outputs for accuracy parity.
Rae T: Marketing wants an embargoed deck within 72h of finish. Legal will need an MoU for aggregated telemetry; I'll start that today.
LynxLabs (Partner): Agree. We prefer review window 48h for partner approval before public release.
ops-bot: CI job created bench/lynx/perf/3645007890 — logs stream at https://ci.redwood.internal/bench/lynx/3645007890
Devon H: smoke run started now, will report baseline numbers in ~30m.
LynxLabs (Partner): Setup window scheduled Mon 07:00 PT. We'll standby for final kernel flags.
Rae T: Owners: Devon = runs/harness, LynxLabs = hardware & power logs, Priya = kernel & traces, Rae = comms/legal. Drop blockers here. :rocket:
